usedFor: anny holds bookings, Sangam CRM holds leads, and “New Booking” in anny can feed “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in anny, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A booking created in your anny organization reaches Sangam CRM as a lead, matched by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Account Is Updated” in Sangam CRM is polling, so “Update Booking Status” in anny acts after a short delay.
